websiteDescription:
Fuel additives and gasoline alone cannot clean away layers of fuel deposits when the engine is running. The only proven method is by removing the “stale” fuel (the cause of the deposits) and using a fuel system cleaner periodically. 
By using Sierra’s Fuel Injection Cleaning System regularly, you will help maintain the fuel injection system’s cleanliness and performance throughout the life of your engine. For best results use Quicksilver Pro Inject-R-Cleaner (QM0062765). 
To also enhance the motors life and performance use Chemtek Petrol Power (260063), suitable for petrol outboard and inboard motors. Simply add to your boats fuel tank.

• Cleaning system container 
• Hose 
• Small fitting 
• Large fitting 
• Carry case
